Critical actions are alpha*t+O(1),alpha a P-critical value. This includes degenerate/coincident critical points and positive-dimensional P-critical sets. The flow itself is not assumed semialgebraic and real chain volume need not shrink. The cut angle is chosen independently of the supporting t-ray. If P-critical values fit a closed half-plane through0,all actual fixed-form periods decay on a supporting ray.
